This is an older flagship (2019). Expected: peak power 3-6W, freq ratio 0.7-0.95, storage 400-700 MB/s.

Let me compute key metrics.

Peak frequency anywhere: 2730000 kHz = 2.73 GHz. That's the Cortex-A75 big core spec for Exynos 9820.

Phase 3 (CPU_STRESS): samples around 166k-240k ms. Freq mostly 1.8-2.3 GHz. Let me look — phase3CpuFreqRatio = 0.76987803 (mobile computed). Let me verify: mean freq in phase 3 / peak anywhere.

Looking at phase 3 samples: freqs like 2210000, 2340000, 2340000, 2314000, 2236000... many around 2002-2340 MHz. Mean maybe ~2100 MHz. 2100000/2730000 = 0.769. Yes matches.

freqDropFromBurstToSustainedPct = 10.599. Hmm, that's mean(freq phase6) vs mean(freq phase3)... Actually formula given: [mean(freq|phase=6) - mean(freq|phase=3)] / mean(freq|phase=6) × 100. Phase 6 freqs are around 1950000 (mostly). Phase 3 mean ~2100. Wait that would give negative. Hmm. Actually maybe it's computed differently. Let me not worry — mobile says 10.6%.

Actually wait, phase 6 (BURST) shows mostly 1950000 with some 1664000, dips to ~1500-1586. Phase 3 mean around 2100. Hmm so phase3 > phase6? That seems odd for "burst". Actually the BURST phase runs short NEON FMA pulses — lower duty, and governor may settle at 1.95 GHz. Whatever.

Let me compute phase 6 mean: many values. Looking at samples, mostly 1950000, 1742000, 1664000, 1846000... mean maybe ~1830 MHz. Hmm.

Anyway, phase3CpuFreqRatio = 0.77 — device sustained 77% of peak. For an older flagship (S10 5G Exynos 9820), that's within the 0.7-0.95 expected band. Good.

CPU usage in phase 3: mobile says phase3CpuUsageAvg = 52.03. But cpuUsageSource = "process_fallback" — so this is app-only share. Per instructions, do NOT infer low usage = idle. State system-wide CPU load unavailable, judge from frequency.

governorCappingDetected = false. satGrade = "fully_saturated". thermalStatusMax = 3 (MODERATE? Actually Android thermal status: 0 NONE, 1 LIGHT, 2 MODERATE, 3 SEVERE, 4 CRITICAL, 5 EMERGENCY, 6 SHUTDOWN). So thermalStatusMax = 3 = SEVERE. Hmm. That's during the scan.
